text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On the way back from stopping by the 
shopping district with Inari One to 
restock training supplies—

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Alright. Looks like we got everything we 
wanted to buy back there!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
"Don't mention it! They're all things I'm 
gonna use anyway. I'd feel bad if I didn't 
do at least this much."

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Step right up, the New Year's Grand Raffle 
is underway~! The grand prize is an 
all-expenses-paid hot springs trip!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
1st prize is the "Special Carrot Hamburg 
Steak"! 2nd prize is "Mountain of 
Carrots"! 3rd prize is "Single Carrot"!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
"Step right up, step right up, it's the 
fun, fun lottery! Anyone and everyone, 
come on over!"

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, a lottery raffle! They're holding one 
around here too, huh!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
I've tried a bunch of times back home too, 
but I almost never win anything. Still, 
it's just human nature to spin it anyway, 
y'know?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Come to think of it, I remembered that I 
received a lottery ticket from shopping 
earlier.
choice_data_list:
Since I have them, I'll give these lottery 
tickets to Inari.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, hold on! You got that ticket from 
Boss's shopping, right? It ain't right if 
Boss doesn't spin it himself.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, hold on! You got that ticket from 
Sis's shopping, right? It ain't right if 
Sis doesn't spin it herself.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The things I bought today are for Inari 
One to use. In other words, this lottery 
ticket was earned by the two of us 
shopping together.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
—Heheh, you sure know what to say. If 
you're gonna put it like that, it makes me 
wanna give it a spin too!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
All right, since we got the chance! Let's 
both spin and bring home somethin' huge!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text: Oh, you two wanna take a spin?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Huh, I'll be counting on this one!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Together with Inari One, I 
enthusiastically spun the lottery wheel!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And the result was—

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Incredible! Congraaaatulations!! The Grand 
Prize, 'Hot Springs Trip Ticket', has been 
won~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: T-T-T-The grand prize?!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
――Hell yeah, hell yeah, hell yeah! Talk 
about a lucky break, grand prize from the 
raffle!! Who'd have thought I'd hit 
something this huge!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Maybe this luck was drawn in by the 
two of us together!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
"Still... 'Hot Springs Trip Ticket'! Isn't 
that just the absolute best! A trip ain't 
complete without a hot spring, after all!"

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Delicious food! A giant bath! Now this is 
what I call a stylish trip! Heheh, I'm 
already looking forward to it...!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
...That said, right now isn't the best 
time. Looks like this ticket has a pretty 
far-off expiration date, so—

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
"Could you hold onto this for a while on 
your end, Trainer?"
choice_data_list: I don't mind, but... are you sure?
I don't mind, but... is that okay?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! I wanna focus on the brawls in the 
JRA this year, and I figured using it as a 
victory celebration after wrapping things 
up would let us kick back and relax even 
better!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, saving the best for last ain't such 
a bad thing, don'tcha think?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Right? Well then, looking forward to that 
time, let's keep giving it our all 
starting tomorrow!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, you won 1st prize~! The 
prize is a "Special Carrot Hamburg Steak"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Hell yeah! You did it, Boss!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Hell yeah! You did it, Sis!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
—Heheh, as expected of the first prize! 
You rarely ever see one of such high 
quality...!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
"If we don't eat it soon, it'd be 
downright disrespectful to Lord Meat! 
Let's dig in back in the trainer's 
office!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, Inari One and I savored the 
premium carrot hamburg steak to our 
hearts' content!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Second prize~!! The prize is a "Mountain 
of Carrots"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Hell yeah! It's a winner, a winner!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Now that's a damn generous prize! To think 
they'd give me this much!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, looks like we've got no choice but 
to throw a carrot festival today. Guess 
I'll ask Creek and the others for a 
hand...!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Of course, you'll be participating in the 
festival too! Come on, there's no time 
like the present!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, we held a Carrot Festival 
together with Inari One's friends and had 
a blast!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text: 3rd prize~! The prize is "one carrot"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Ooh, hit the jackpot!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
—Heheh, that's one fine carrot. No doubt 
it'll taste amazing just eaten raw!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Let's split it up and eat it once we get 
back. How do you like to eat yours?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, Inari One and I split and ate 
the prize carrots together!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Too bad, you lost! Your consolation prize 
is a pack of tissues~

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Gwaaah! I missed the mark, dang it!!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, Boss! After you went outta your way 
to give me a chance and all! I can't 
believe I blew it here...!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, Sis! After you went outta your way 
to give me a chance and all! I can't 
believe I blew it here...!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Even so, dammit...! That ain't stylish, 
ain't stylish at all! Gaaah, this pisses 
me off so much!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Inari One ended up feeling far more 
downhearted about pulling a blank than I 
had expected...
